implementation.instructions: Use current host file tools; inspect metadata, preserve originals and use new paths.
Use current host advertised local image viewing, including original-size detail views. Missing vision blocks inspection; do not replace vision with metadata.

Resolve the canonical Skill from a managed link or its installation source marker; load the matching package Skill. Use node <owning-package-root>/bin/product-reference-replacement.mjs for board render/check and asset freeze/import. Select generic plus one category template, preserve source regions, inspect actual board and 1600/1920 previews, and enforce the visual/geometry contract. Never infer user approval from technical success. For mode A use board plan/status, panel prepare/attach/review, then board compose; preserve fixed boxes and all other panel originals when revising one panel. Deliver n original images plus the board.

Resolve this Skill root and run job create/status/collect and round prepare/attach/review through the product-reference-replacement package CLI. The scripts never submit media generation. Record an inspected blueprint before preparing new jobs; bind its hash and use product/scene/contact/occlusion/text review checks. Legacy jobs remain recoverable.

Resolve sealseek-media skill source --json; load its complete canonical Skill and current host adapter. Verify live nano-banana-pro contract and follow the same saved task; return downloaded summary to B2. All generative image work exclusively uses @petercjl/sealseek-media-cli with nano-banana-pro; native imagegen, alternative providers and direct API fallbacks are prohibited. Missing capability blocks generation. Return one original image and the same saved task to A2 panel review or B2 round review; A references are original product evidence, B references are scene then asset.
Resolve longslice skill source; load current semantic-image-slicer Skill. Complete analyze, actual preview inspection and cut; return ordered slices and coordinates to A1.
